entry.title: Hear My Baby Heartbeat App
entry.content:
优惠信息（价格：HK$ 58.00 → 免費 [免費 ~ HK$ 58.00]）

全部价格信息

价格：免費

App 內購買

  • All Access Yearly：HK$ 228.00
  • Early Access Weekly：HK$ 18.00
  • All Access Weekly：HK$ 38.00

应用描述

Trusted by over 500,000 families. The original, best-in-class baby heart sounds app to hear baby beat at home with your iPhone. Hear My Baby uses your iPhone microphone to help you listen to baby heart sounds. HMB 2.0 adds AI chat support, tailored tutorials, and pregnancy reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to help you get results faster, and is now free to download. Why parents choose Hear My Baby Heartbeat App - Hear your baby’s heartbeat using the iPhone’s built-in microphone — no accessories required - AI chat support provides step-by-step help with setup, positioning and recording conditions - Enhances low-frequency audio captured by the iPhone microphone to help users listen for and save special pregnancy sounds. - Tailored tutorial adapts to your stage of pregnancy and setup - Create baby sex reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to share the moment - Record & save clips; build a personal timeline you can revisit - Share easily with family and friends (Instagram, WhatsApp, email) - Designed by parents with expertise in sound engineering, AI and app development; warm, honest guidance throughout - Privacy first — you control what’s saved and shared Real 5 Star Reviews "I never leave reviews, let along pay for apps but let’s just say I tried this , and it def works" - Lov3r_Gurl IG (USA Sept 2025) “I always find 'it' (sic) eventually and the rhythm is clear and strong. I love that I can record them to keep.” - T Lucker (Australia 2025) "I downloaded this very skeptical... It took me about 45 minutes of laying down, very still, with noise canceling headphones on, but I HEARD IT. I am almost 18 weeks pregnant. From one momma to the next, it’s worth it." - Baby'sHeartbeat (2025) “It took some time and patience... thank you for creating this cheap, awesome technology to use at home.” — Niki “I was skeptical at first. Great app! Worth it.” — Legretta How it works - Hear My Baby uses your iPhone’s microphone to listen for abdominal sounds; it is not a doppler and doesn’t emit ultrasound. It’s a lifestyle keepsake for bonding and sharing, not a medical device and not for diagnosis. - Our advanced audio engine isolates and amplifies fetal heartbeat sounds so you can listen and save the recording, and trim it to the appropriate moment for sharing quickly and easily. - Best from around 16+ weeks; clearest for many families at ~27 weeks. Results vary with baby’s position and placenta location. Tips for best results - Be still, breathe lightly, and try several positions around your bump - Press the mic firmly against the skin; explore low and to the sides - Bluetooth/over-ear headphones can make subtle sounds easier to hear Important Hear My Baby is not a medical device and doesn’t replace prenatal care. If you’re concerned about anything in your pregnancy, please consult your clinician. Seek a doctor’s advice if you have any concerns. You can switch to Airplane Mode while using the app. Privacy Your moments are yours. You decide what to keep or delete — and who gets to hear them. Subscribe to access to premium app features; subscription details are the following: - Length: weekly, yearly - Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase - You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase - Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period - The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period - When cancelling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded - Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription Terms of Use: https://www.hearmybabyapp.com/eula

《Way of the Hunter》將推出手機端系列首作，太平洋西北地區的壯美景觀隨之鋪陳眼前。 在美國內茲珀斯谷的廣闊開放世界中，體驗最真實的狩獵與探索。在风景如画的自然栖息地中发现栩栩如生的动物，使用各种细节逼真的武器。 《獵人征途》的野生動物外型真實而美麗，且具備符合現實的動物群體行為特徵，提供玩家全面且真實的狩獵體驗，讓人能完全沉浸在遊戲世界。親眼目睹複雜多樣的生態環境產生的變化，周遭環境會因為你的行動而出現變動及反應。瞭解真正的獵人所代表的意義，並充分運用自己的技能來戰勝考驗。 面對人道狩獵的挑戰、搭配引人入勝的故事情節進行遊戲，或是單純地在這富饒的自然環境中自由狩獵。 * 數十種細節精緻的動物物種與真實的行為模式，為你帶來真正身歷其境的狩獵體驗 * 醒目標示動物跡象、血跡分析，以及能夠倒回觀看子彈鏡頭的射擊回顧畫面，這些功能都能讓您像專業獵人一樣狩獵 * 使用獵人感官將重要詳情和資訊醒目標示出來，或者關閉獵人感官，讓遊戲體驗更具挑戰性 * 複雜的戰利品系統，其會根據身體素質與年齡等多項因素產生獨一無二的鹿角和動物頭角 * 細膩又自然的動物動作，以及動物察覺到玩家存在時的真實反應 * 24 小時的日夜循環，再加上風和天氣的變化 * 真實彈道與子彈物理模擬 * 大量槍枝和裝備選擇，其中包含證照管制裝備，例如：Bushnell、Federal、Leupold、Primos、Remington 和 Steyr Arms * 遊戲內的經營模式讓玩家可以獵取野味之後，將販賣肉品所得的資金用於購買新裝備、狩獵通行證以及戰利品狩獵台上的標本 * 引人入勝的故事情節，訴說著一段關於家族狩獵事業的掙扎糾葛，以及圍繞其間的競爭關係和友誼 * 直觀的相片模式，讓你可以捕捉並分享自己最愛的瞬間 * 使用手柄或觸控控制追蹤獵物 * 優化手機端操控，兼顧舒適與效率 警告： 不支援記憶體小於 4 GB 的裝置！ 您需要至少 6 GB 記憶體的裝置才能使用最高圖形設定。 © www.handy-games.com GmbH

应用描述

Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them. Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close. Features: - Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells - Choose between loose, normal or tight setting - Loudness boost option
